workshop_summary: Objective: produce a recommended reserved-GPU plan that meets latency SLOs and cost targets for 12-month run rate.
Input data: sampled traffic traces covering 2 weeks (avg QPS, 95th percentile QPS, token per request histogram), batch size distributions.
Baseline observed: steady-state 35 QPS (single-turn), median tokens/request = 420, 95th tokens/request = 1,200.
Peak observed: 5x bursts up to 180 QPS lasting 2-7 minutes; nightly batch embedding rebuilds for 10M documents (~off-peak window).
Throughput target: maintain p95 latency < 200ms for chat and < 350ms for reranking at steady-state capacity.
Token/sec budget calculation (steady): 35 QPS * 420 tokens = 14,700 tokens/sec average; 95th token/sec during peaks ~ 180 QPS * 1,200 tokens = 216,000 tokens/sec (burst).

GPU recommendation: reserve 6x A100-80GB-equivalent for steady-state (handles baseline + margin), configure autoscale/burst pool to add up to 10 GPUs during sustained peaks; optional H100 pool for heavy batching during nightly rebuilds.
Compression/quantization: recommend int4 quantization + kernel tuning to reduce memory pressure and increase concurrent contexts per GPU.
Routing/fallbacks: policy to downgrade to 13B variant under extreme capacity strain; golden path to route high-priority customer conversations to reserved pool.

SLA items raised: explicit throughput guarantee (min tokens/sec per second), rollback/fallback behavior, credits for missed SLOs, scheduled maintenance windows and blackout windows during settlement events.
Metrics to include in contract: p50/p95/p99 latency for generation, sustained tokens/sec, request success rate, provisioned GPU health, cost per 1k tokens for billing reconciliation.
sizing_details: Steady-state: 6x A100-80GB (reserved) — covers 14.7k tokens/sec baseline with headroom for 2x median growth.
Burst strategy: autoscale to 10 GPUs for up to 10 minutes; use pre-warmed instances for <60s cold-start mitigation.
Nightly batch: 2x H100 spot/ephemeral instances recommended for embedding rebuilds (cost optimized, isolated network path).
Expected utilization: steady-state 60-70% GPU utilization; target 95th latency margin by dynamic batching and KV prefix caching.
Estimated throughput per GPU (A100, Llama-2-70B-quant4): ~25k tokens/sec (in optimized kernel path).
poC_plan: 6-week pilot: week 1 onboarding + infra provisioning; week 2-3 traffic replay + tuning; week 4 SLA test (synthetic spikes); week 5-6 stability run + cost reporting.
Deliverables: tuning report, final reserved SKU recommendation, SLO wording for contract, acceptance test results.
Success criteria: p95 latency under steady-state target for 7-day window, no more than 1 missed SLO event in pilot, embedding job completes in maintenance window.
pricing_expectations: Customer expects 30-40% discount vs on-demand for reserved commit, wants committed throughput SLAs tied to credits.
Open to a tiered pricing: base reserved fee + per-token overage pricing for bursts above reserved tokens/sec threshold.
legal_and_sla_notes: Brookline legal wants explicit credit formula for missed throughput SLOs and definition of force majeure for market events.
Data residency clause must guarantee backups remain in EU region for EU customer data; redact policy for logs older than 90 days.
